title: Pew Research Center: AI Chatbots in Health
discussion_signal: The relay describes growing use of AI chatbots for health information and a sharp legitimacy gap for mental-health use, where respondents are more likely to see potential harm than benefit. Discussion treats speed and accessibility as coexisting with privacy and relational-care concerns.
linked_research_question: When does low-cost AI health navigation expand access, and when do privacy, accuracy, and the need for human relational authority limit legitimacy?
limits: Post is a secondary relay of Pew survey findings
Perceived helpfulness is not clinical validity or improved health outcomes
